note: Wikidata q-ids only. Ten of these thirteen places are carried over from the Explorer product on origin/main, whose text is the raw material for the city file; their q-ids were already matched in docs/world/research/explorer-pins.json and every one of them checked out. The three additions are the two museums with an interior, which Explorer has no model for, and the Sainte-Chapelle. No entrance is claimed: no door here has been measured, so every point is the centroid or area it actually is.

places.name: Musée du Louvre
places.note: The museum, not the pyramid. Explorer pins the Pyramide du Louvre (Q13397), which sits 12 m from the museum's own point and would fail the separation audit as an undeclared neighbour. The pyramid is the door a visitor walks through, so it belongs inside the museum's story rather than as a pin of its own.
